title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Travon Walker (rib) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Travon Walker did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Walker played through the injury last week. He starts out this week missing practice.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Leonard Williams (stinger) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Leonard Williams did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Williams remains uncertain heading into Sunday's game against the Raiders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashid Shaheed (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Rashid Shaheed was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Shaheed appears likely to return for the Seahawks. He'll remain a WR4/WR5 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Uchenna Nwosu (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Uchenna Nwosu was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Nwosu appears on track to have a chance to return on Sunday against the Raiders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quenton Nelson (knee) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Quenton Nelson did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Nelson's status remains uncertain heading into Sunday's game against the Raiders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Drew Lock (elbow/oblique) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Drew Lock was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Lock remains on track to start another game for the Seahawks on Sunday against the Raiders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Charles Cross (ankle) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Charles Cross did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Cross remains uncertain heading into Week 10 against the Raiders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Bradford (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Anthony Bradford was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bradford's role will be dependent on the status of Quenton Nelson.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: James Pearce Jr. misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: James Pearce Jr. did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Pearce made his season debut last week after serving an eight-game suspension. He was limited to 15 snaps in his first game of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carlton Davis III (knee) ruled out for Week 10
items.desc: Carlton Davis III has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lions.
items.impact: Davis gets ruled out early in the week due to a knee issue.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ben Brown (knee) ruled out for Week 10
items.desc: Ben Brown has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lions.
items.impact: Brown gets ruled out early in the week due to a knee issue.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out for Week 10
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson has been ruled out for Week 10 against the Lions.
items.impact: Henderson will remain sidelined due to an illness. He holds no clear timetable to return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Rhamondre Stevenson did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Stevenson came out of Week 9 battling a knee tendon issue. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: A.J. Brown (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: A.J. Brown was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is a positive sign for Brown to start the week after he traveled with the Patriots to Germany. His status will need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Benford (wrist) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Benford was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Benford is managing a wrist injury. He is on track to be good to go for Week 10.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alec Anderson (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Alec Anderson was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Anderson is managing a neck injury. He is on track to be good to go for Week 10.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Connor McGovern (neck) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Connor McGovern was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McGovern is managing a neck injury. He is on track to be good to go for Week 10.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dion Dawkins (rib) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Dion Dawkins was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dawkins was sidelined in Week 9 for the Bills. His status in practice on Wednesday is a positive sign for his status heading into Week 10.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Spencer Brown (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Spencer Brown was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Brown is managing an ankle issue. He should still be good to go for Week 10.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dalton Kincaid (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Dalton Kincaid was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kincaid is managing an ankle issue. He should still be good to go for Week 10.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Riley Patterson signs with Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens signed kicker Riley Patterson.
items.impact: Patterson gets the opportunity following a workout. He will kick for Baltimore on Monday against the Chargers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Amik Robertson (ankle) cleared to play Thursday
items.desc: Amik Robertson (ankle) has been cleared to play in Thursday night's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Robertson will be available to play on Thursday night, despite dealing with an ankle issue of some kind at practice throughout the week. His presence is much needed for the Commanders ahead of a divisional matchup against the Giants in primetime.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alvin Kamara not seen practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara was not seen practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kamara usually has his practice reps managed early in the week. He should still be good to go for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Colson Yankoff (knee) unavailable for Thursday
items.desc: Colson Yankoff (knee) will be unavailable for Thursday night's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Yankoff recently suffered a knee injury and will not be available to play on Thursday night as a result. His absence may lead to slightly more work for John Bates against the Giants.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: T.J. Hockenson (wrist/chest) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: T.J. Hockenson did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hockenson appears to have suffered the injuries in Monday's loss against the Bills. He will need to be monitored in practice on a short week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jauan Jennings (calf) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jauan Jennings did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jennings missed Week 9 against the Bills. He remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Treylon Burks (foot) will play Thursday
items.desc: Treylon Burks (foot) will play in Thursday night's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Burks was sidelined for one game while recovering from a foot injury, but it's no longer a serious issue and he has been fully cleared to make his return to the lineup on Thursday night. His return will help the fantasy value of QB Jayden Daniels in this matchup, though it remains to be seen if Burks will see enough work to be relevant himself.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bam Knight (concussion) returns to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Bam Knight resumed practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Knight remains in concussion protocol. If he gets cleared in time for Sunday, he'll figure to return to his committee role alongside Tyler Allgeier in the Cardinals backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Wright (quad) practicing in full for Week 10
items.desc: Jaylen Wright is practicing in full for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: Wright missed last week with the quad issue. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lucas Patrick (concussion) won't play Thursday
items.desc: Lucas Patrick (concussion) won't play in Thursday night's game against the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Patrick is currently going through the NFL's concussion protocols and is going to be sidelined on Thursday night as a result. Washington's offensive front will be even weaker than usual as a result of his absence against the Giants.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Justin Fields (neck) practicing in full for Week 10
items.desc: Justin Fields is practicing in full for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
items.impact: Patrick Mahomes II (elbow) is also practicing in full. Fields will remain in his backup role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashee Rice (knee) practicing in full for Week 10
items.desc: Rashee Rice is practicing in full for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
items.impact: Rice had previously been managing a hamstring injury which appears to be behind him. He'll remain a WR2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) good to go for Thursday
items.desc: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) is good to go for Thursday night's game against the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Skattebo missed last week's game due to a hamstring issue he's still managing, but he is off of the injury report and expected to be good to go for Thursday night's matchup. Fantasy managers should expect him to start and see a lot of work in this big divisional game against the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Travis Kelce (ankle) practicing in full for Week 10
items.desc: Travis Kelce is practicing in full for Sunday's game against the Falcons.
items.impact: Kelce will remain a borderline TE1 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: J.J. McCarthy (hip) off injury report for Thursday
items.desc: J.J. McCarthy (hip) is off of the injury report for Thursday night's game against the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: McCarthy suffered a hip injury in Week 9, but he is now off of the team's injury report ahead of Thursday night's game and is going to be a full go against the Commanders. Fantasy managers should continue to expect mixed results from the young quarterback, though he might struggle more this week if he's still managing the lingering effects of his injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II (elbow) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes II was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mahomes remains on track to be a full-go for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (knee) missed practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Spears was unable to practice on Wednesday. He has been dealing with this knee issue for a while, and it looks like the team's bye week wasn't enough to get him fully healthy. He's at risk of missing another game this week, which would lead to more work for Tony Pollard in Tennessee's backfield.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring/back) limited Wednesday
items.desc: DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring/back) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Overshown was able to practice in a limited capacity on Wednesday. He missed last week's game due to a pair of issues, but he seems to be recovering well and may be back in Week 10. Dallas' defense will see a nice boost whenever he's back and fully healthy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: KaVontae Turpin (ribs) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: KaVontae Turpin (ribs) was limited at Dallas' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Turpin was able to log a limited practice session on Wednesday, despite having an injury to his ribs that he's dealing with at the moment. If he's able to play in Week 10, he will see more work in the event that George Pickens (hamstring) is unable to suit up for the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trent McDuffie (back) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Trent McDuffie will not return to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Rams coach Sean McVay said the team remains hopeful McDuffie can return on Sunday against the Cardinals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonathan Mingo (ankle) sidelined at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jonathan Mingo (ankle) was sidelined at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mingo suffered an ankle injury during Sunday's win over the Colts. He didn't practice on Wednesday because of it, and it seems likely to leave him sidelined in Week 10, though we won't know for sure until later in the week. He will see a lot less opportunities whenever George Pickens (hamstring) is back in the lineup as well.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) was absent from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: As expected, Ferguson was not able to practice on Wednesday after suffering a couple of lower body injuries in Week 9's win over the Colts. He will almost certainly be out this week because of that, which will leave Brevyn Spann-Ford with more work than usual against the 49ers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) returns to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Travis Etienne Jr. had his practice window opened on Wednesday.
items.impact: Etienne has been on injured reserve with a hamstring injury. He will have 21 days to be activated.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) missed Pittsburgh's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It was previously reported that the veteran was expected to practice on Wednesday, but he didn't end up taking part and was officially a non-participant. It remains to be seen if he will play in Week 10, and Dallas' secondary will be considerably worse if he has to sit out for another week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: George Pickens (hamstring) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: George Pickens (hamstring) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Pickens has missed some time recently due to a hamstring issue, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, so it seems like his health is improving considerably. It remains to be seen if he will be ready to make his return to the lineup in Week 10, however, so fantasy managers should continue to closely monitor his status over the course of the practice week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) considered week-to-week
items.desc: Mike Evans (Achilles) is considered week-to-week at this point.
items.impact: Evans is still recovering from an Achilles injury, and the team has no concrete timetable for his return beyond considering him week-to-week at this point. That makes him unlikely to play in Week 10, which would lead to more fantasy value for Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) and Keenan Allen for the time being.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Puka Nacua (knee/toe) won't land on IR, still out for extended time
items.desc: Puka Nacua (knee/toe) will not land on injured reserve due to roster logistics, but he is still expected to be sidelined for around 4-6 weeks
items.impact: The Rams are not going to place Nacua on injured reserve, not because he will be back sooner than expected, but rather just as a roster management tactic. This is significant for fantasy managers, as he may not be eligible for an IR slot in many league formats as a result of this. That will make him significantly harder to roster for the 4-6 weeks that he's expected to be out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Renardo Green (back) will miss practice Wednesday
items.desc: Renardo Green (back) will miss San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: A back issue will leave Green sidelined at practice on Wednesday. It's not expected to be a serious issue, but there's an off-chance that it will leave him sidelined in Week 10, which would be less than ideal for San Francisco's secondary this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) expected to be limited Wednesday
items.desc: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) is expected to return to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday.
items.impact: Samuel has been out for a while due to a nagging hamstring issue, but he is going to return to practice on Wednesday and is expected to be a limited participant. He will have a chance to play in Week 10, but we won't know his status for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Deommodore Lenoir (foot) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Deommodore Lenoir (foot) is not taking part in San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Lenoir recently suffered a foot issue of some kind and won't be practicing on Wednesday as a result. He's considered day-to-day right now, so it looks more likely than not that he will be available to play in Week 10.
